answer: CD14 Mono (classical monocytes) has the highest number of significantly differentially expressed genes after AAV9 mini-dystrophin treatment: 315 genes with p_val_adj < 0.05 (Post vs Pre), a count that is unchanged (315) when additionally requiring |avg_log2FC| > 0.25. The runner-up immune cell type is CD16 Mono (240), then NK (118).
